# JSON File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for JSON documents.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. Adds `title`, `excerpt`, `content`, `rootType`, `keyCount` and `lineCount`, filled by an
extraction pass that parses the document and records its shape rather than only
its bytes. Its `previewComponent` renders a structured, collapsible view, and
`rootType`/`keyCount` are what let a fitted card describe the payload without
reading it.

Accepts: `.json, application/json`

## Example
```ts
import { JsonFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/json-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(JsonFileDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
